lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity white circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns. Posterior to the gills, columns contain roughly 2-3 primary nodes each, spanning the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Light-colored vertical bands intersect with faint horizontal lines to form a series of rectangular frames; the primary white blobs are centrally located within these darker rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin surface exhibits a distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs; smaller spots are clustered near the anterior margin with larger nodes in the central area.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high density of small, stochastic spots that transition into larger, regularly spaced nodes on the post-branchial flank.
